mapper.sql: id,owner_user_id AS ownerUserId,`separator`,`comment`,revision,create_by AS createBy,update_by AS updateBy,create_time AS createTime,update_time AS updateTime
mapper.select: SELECT FROM paiflow_text_config WHERE id=#{id} AND owner_user_id=#{owner} AND owner_user_id>0 FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM paiflow_text_config WHERE owner_user_id IN(0,#{owner}) ORDER BY create_time DESC,id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM paiflow_text_config WHERE owner_user_id IN(0,#{owner}) AND `separator`=#{separator} AND id<>#{excludeId}
mapper.update: UPDATE paiflow_text_config SET `separator`=#{separator},`comment`=#{comment},revision=revision+1,update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE id=#{id} AND owner_user_id=#{ownerUserId} AND owner_user_id>0 AND revision=#{revision}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM paiflow_text_config WHERE id=#{id} AND owner_user_id=#{owner} AND owner_user_id>0 AND revision=#{revision}
